title: Proper mate pasting along a commuting triangle
statement:
For an arbitrary commutative condensed ring Λ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], use the canonical unbounded pullback L and right direct image R, and the specified exchange β [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange, def-sfb-compact-support-base-change-maps]. Let a:A→B, p:B→Y, q:A→Y satisfy e:a;p=q, and let v:Y'→Y. Write A'=A×_Y Y', B'=B×_Y Y', v_A:A'→A, v_B:B'→B, q':A'→Y', p':B'→Y', and a':A'→B' for the canonical pullback of a. Let κ(a,p,q,e):Ra;Rp≅Rq be the inverse K-injective-normalized direct-image compositor [det-sf-comp-coherence-refinement] followed by transport along e. The pullback square for a has its canonical Cartesian realization, hence its specified mate β_a:v_B*Ra→Ra'v_A*. For W and maps s:W→A', r:W→B', z:W→Y' satisfying s;q'=z, r;p'=z and s;a'=r, take arbitrary M∈D(A), N∈D(W), and t:v_A*M→Rs N. Let b:Rp;v*→v_B*;Rp' be specified with b=β_p, so its components remain abstract during the calculation. Then, in diagrammatic order,
v*κ(a,p,q,e)_M ; β_q,M ; Rq'(t) ; κ(s,q',z)_N = b_RaM ; Rp'(β_a,M ; Ra'(t) ; κ(s,a',r)_N) ; κ(r,p',z)_N.
This statement does not involve opens, compactifications, extension by zero, density, localizing closure, or invertibility of β or t.

source.place: Proof (2), proper exchange on the localizing generators; proof (3), identity on the open and mate pasting.

proof.text: Substitute b=β_p. The canonical direct-image triangle comparator is the inverse normalized derived compositor followed by the equality of scheme maps. Pull back a by the universal property of the literal fibre products; pullback pasting proves its square Cartesian. These constructions require no existence choice.

Normalize direct-image composition by its K-injective derived units. Its inverse is the conjugate of the exact pullback composition comparison, after the canonical comparison of exact and total derived pullbacks. Pullback composition associativity identifies the rectangle for q with the paste of the squares for a and p.
Apply horizontal mate pasting and conjugate-mate compatibility to identify exchange for q with exchange for p followed by exchange for a, inserting the two normalized triangle comparisons.

Move the arbitrary arrow t across the pulled-back triangle comparison by naturality. The two triple direct-image comparators into Rz agree: on a K-injective resolution both are the ordinary triple compositor and the coefficient identifications agree by associativity. Use s;a'=r and the two equations to z to identify the equality transports. This gives exactly the displayed formula. The calculation is an equality and requires no invertibility of an exchange.

theorem compactSupportProperTriangle_pasting
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {A B Y Y' W : Scheme.{u}} (a : A ⟶ B) (p : B ⟶ Y) (q : A ⟶ Y)
    (e : a ≫ p = q) (v : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (s : W ⟶ pullback q v) (r : W ⟶ pullback p v) (z : W ⟶ Y')
    (es : s ≫ pullback.snd q v = z) (er : r ≫ pullback.snd p v = z)
    (esr : s ≫ compactSupportTrianglePullback a p q e v = r)
    (M : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology A) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ A)))
    (N : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ W)))
    (t : (detSfDerivedPullback Λ (pullback.fst q v)).obj M ⟶ R((s)_*⟦Λ⟧).obj N)
    (b : R((p)_*⟦Λ⟧) ⋙ detSfDerivedPullback Λ v ⟶
      detSfDerivedPullback Λ (pullback.fst p v) ⋙ R((pullback.snd p v)_*⟦Λ⟧))
    (hb : b = detSfProperBaseChangeMap Λ p v) :
    (detSfDerivedPullback Λ v).map
        ((compactSupportPushforwardTriangle Λ a p q e).hom.app M) ≫
      (detSfProperBaseChangeMap Λ q v).app M ≫
      R((pullback.snd q v)_*⟦Λ⟧).map t ≫
      (compactSupportPushforwardTriangle Λ s (pullback.snd q v) z es).hom.app N =
    b.app (R((a)_*⟦Λ⟧).obj M) ≫
      R((pullback.snd p v)_*⟦Λ⟧).map
        ((condensedAmbientExchange Λ (compactSupportTrianglePullbackSquare a p q e v)).app M ≫
          R((compactSupportTrianglePullback a p q e v)_*⟦Λ⟧).map t ≫
          (compactSupportPushforwardTriangle Λ s
            (compactSupportTrianglePullback a p q e v) r esr).hom.app N) ≫
      (compactSupportPushforwardTriangle Λ r (pullback.snd p v) z er).hom.app N
